# Overflow list checks (Chrome DevTools MCP)

1. Open `/tests/fixtures/components/overflow-list/` on the existing Vite server, with an `initScript` that records `window` `error` events from the start. Run `await (await import('/tests/fixtures/components/overflow-list/api.ts')).verifyOverflowList()` through MCP evaluation and expect every assertion message back (no thrown error, no window errors during load). Repeat with `?package` after `npm run build`.
2. At rest: the item limit reads First aid · Forklift · Spanish · `+5`, and `+5` · Catering · Photography · Signage from the start. The two-row list fills two rows of its 360 px box and ends with the count; the start, right-to-left (`+8` on the left, written `+8`) and vertical boxes keep one or two rows; the flex, grid and table tracks show four items and `+8`; the inline-block list shows its three items whole; the custom count is a Button reading `+8`.
3. Drag the resize handles of the row boxes from wide to narrow and back: the lists never exceed their rows, the count shows alone at the narrowest width, and the paragraph after the two-row list never moves while the fitted rows stay the same. Re-running the same width gives the same partition.
4. Insert a list of links and press Tab through it with real key presses: only shown links receive focus, the omitted ones are skipped. Narrowing the list while a shown link has focus omits it and focus returns to the document.
5. Inspect the accessibility tree: shown items, then the count read as "N more" (the custom count as its button name); omitted items are absent. Inject `/node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js` and run it on the sections: no violations.
6. Inspect light and dark themes: outline item Badges, a secondary count Badge with tabular figures, no surface on the list. Override `::part(overflow-list)` `gap`/`padding-inline` and `::part(overflow-list-count)` `color`: the overrides apply and the list refits to its rows.
7. Open the closed disclosure: its list fits and announces `tp-overflow-change` with reason `initial` only once it renders.
